objective: Bring 4 Carved Stone Urns to Prospector Ironband in Loch Modan.

description: The last report I received from Agmond is troubling, more so now that he's dead!  He mentioned that his diggers uncovered "ancient urns" at the dig site outside Uldaman.  I fear that the urns he found at that site incited the troggs, just as did the idols I found here.
I need you to get those urns for our studies.  Go to the Uldaman site, gather the urns, then return to me.
progress: Did you find those urns, <name>? We must find the link between them and the troggs!
completion: Well done! With luck and diligence, we will find whatever link exists between the troggs and these ancient artifacts.
You have done a great deed for the Prospectors, <name>. Your efforts will not be forgotten. And neither will Agmond.
